description: This file defines the ServerRequestFactory class in the Slim Framework, responsible for creating PSR-7 ServerRequest objects from various sources, including global server variables and method parameters.

classes.name: ServerRequestFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating PSR-7 ServerRequest objects, with methods to create requests from parameters or global server variables.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes stream and URI factories, with default implementations if none provided.

methods.name: createServerRequest
methods.description: Creates a ServerRequest object based on method, URI, and server parameters.

methods.name: createFromGlobals
methods.description: Static method to create a ServerRequest object from PHP's global server variables, including handling of input streams and parsed bodies.
